sql: SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status
SELECT id, title, status, desk FROM article WHERE status IN ['c_11','c_23']
SELECT id, article, kind, text FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7]
SELECT id, heading, body FROM factbox WHERE body CONTAINS 'kill' OR body CONTAINS 'pull' OR heading CONTAINS 'kill' OR heading CONTAINS 'pull'
SELECT id, text FROM brief WHERE text CONTAINS 'kill' OR text CONTAINS 'pull' OR text CONTAINS 'spike'
SELECT status, published_at FROM article WHERE status IN ['c_11','c_23'] ORDER BY status
SELECT status, math::min(published_at) AS min_p, math::max(published_at) AS max_p, count() FROM article GROUP BY status
SELECT kind, text, article FROM brief WHERE kind = 't2'
SELECT id, status, (SELECT count() FROM brief WHERE article = $parent.id) AS n_brief, (SELECT count() FROM factbox WHERE article = $parent.id) AS n_fact FROM article WHERE status IN ['c_11','c_23']
